justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/ObservableInputStream.java` and `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/ProxyInputStream.java`. The target `Builder` is only lines 79-91 in `ObservableInputStream.java`: one empty constructor and one override of `get()` that just returns `new ObservableInputStream(this)`. It holds no own fields or additional behavior; the mutable builder state lives in `ObservableInputStream.AbstractBuilder` (observers) and the superclass `ProxyInputStream.AbstractBuilder` (afterRead). This is a thin factory wrapper, not a class with clearly separable responsibilities, so insufficient modularization is not present.
